chunks: And from him, from Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Musa ibn al-Fadl, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from one who narrated to him, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him, 'What do you say about the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?' He replied, 'Visit him and do not neglect him, for indeed he is the Master of the Martyrs and the Master of the Youth of Paradise, and he is similar to Yahya ibn Zakariyya, and over the two of them the heavens and the earth wept.'

key_terms.بَكَتِ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ: The heavens and the earth wept

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and significance of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) emphasizes the spiritual necessity of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s (a.s.) shrine, warning against neglect ('la tajfahu') to maintain a living connection with the Ahl al-Bayt. The comparison to Yahya ibn Zakariyya highlights their shared prophetic lineage and purity, while the cosmic weeping of the heavens and earth underscores the universal significance of their martyrdom in Shia cosmology.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father narrated to me from Sa’d, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Mūsā ibn Faďl, from ‘Ali ibn Ḥakam, from someone who narrated to him, from Ḥanān ibn Sadīr, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “What do you say about going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” Imam (a.s.) replied: Go to his Ziyārah and do not neglect him, for verily he is the Master of the Martyrs and he is the Master of the Youth of Paradise. Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā (a.s.) is similar to Ḥusain (a.s.) and the heavens and the earth wept (only) over the two of them.
